description: IRVE dynamique (organisation Parera Mobilité) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PARERA MOBILITE. This dataset meets the specifications of the "dynamic EVIR" schema available on schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: PARERA MOBILITE. The portal shows the English title as "Dynamic IRVE (Parera Mobility Organization)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is PARERA MOBILITE. Its keywords include fichier-irve-de-bornes-de-recharge, irve-stations-de-recharge, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
